charts.title: Contract usage
charts.query:
-- Daily contract usage: function-call receipts, distinct contracts called,
-- and on-chain activity of the NEAR Intents contract (intents.near).
-- Partition filter on block_date keeps the scan to the requested days only.
SELECT
  block_date,
  COUNT(*)                                     AS function_calls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_receiver_account_id)  AS contracts_called,
  COUNTIF(receipt_receiver_account_id = 'intents.near') AS intents_contract_calls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(receipt_receiver_account_id = 'intents.near',
                    receipt_predecessor_account_id, NULL)) AS intents_contract_callers
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions`
WHERE block_date BETWEEN @start_date AND @end_date
  AND action_kind = 'FUNCTION_CALL'
GROUP BY block_date
ORDER BY block_date;

charts.title: NEAR Intents volume (USD)
charts.query:
GET https://api.llama.fi/summary/dexs/near-intents  ->  totalDataChart (daily USD volume, public, no key)

GET https://explorer.near-intents.org/api/v0/transactions?startTimestampUnix=<hour start>&endTimestampUnix=<hour end>&numberOfTransactions=1000
Authorization: Bearer $NEAR_INTENTS_JWT
-> 2 random UTC hours per day (seeded by date), every swap in each hour (paged);
   daily swaps = mean(successful swaps per sampled hour) x 24
charts.sentence: NEAR Intents moved $125.81M a day over the last 30 days; it moved $128.3K a day in its first 30 days on DefiLlama (2024-12-10).

charts.query:
GET https://explorer.near-intents.org/api/v0/transactions?startTimestampUnix=<hour start>&endTimestampUnix=<hour end>&numberOfTransactions=1000
Authorization: Bearer $NEAR_INTENTS_JWT

   daily swaps = mean(successful swaps per sampled hour) x 24
charts.sentence: From 71 sampled hours, NEAR Intents handled about 17.3K successful swaps a day over the last 30 days.
